subject: Coordination: demo timing — added governance, infra & procurement attendees
messages:
From: Michael Donovan <michael.donovan@bluepeak.io>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: ops-security@bluepeak.com, procurement@bluepeak.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo this week — added stakeholders on our side

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for arranging the demo for next Tuesday. A quick update from our side — security and procurement just looped in and asked to attend the walkthrough so they can validate controls and procurement terms before we proceed.

Unfortunately a few of the folks from infrastructure are traveling next week (SF conference) and won't be back until the 25th. Given the number of stakeholders, would you be open to moving the session to the week of Feb 24 so we can get the right people on the call?

Key asks from our side:
- Security wants 20–30 minutes on data handling, network/topology, and audit logs.
- Procurement wants a short run through of contract SLAs and data retention language.
- Infra would like an architecture slide and a quick Q&A.

Can you share a few options the week of Feb 24? We can provide attendee list once slots are proposed.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Donovan
Head of Platform Engineering | BluePeak Industries
michael.donovan@bluepeak.io
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Michael Donovan <michael.donovan@bluepeak.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo this week — added stakeholders on our side

Thanks for the heads up, Michael — understood and totally reasonable to reconvene when all the stakeholders can attend.

We can accommodate the week of Feb 24. To make the session efficient, I suggest:
- 10 minute intro + business context
- 30 minute platform demo focused on integrations, security model, and KV/prefix caching behavior
- 15 minute procurement/terms and Q&A with Neha
- 15 minute infra architecture Q&A with Vivek

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue, Feb 24 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT
- Wed, Feb 25 — 11:00–12:00 PM PT
- Thu, Feb 26 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT

I attached an updated deck (redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf) and a procurement checklist (procurement-checklist.xlsx) that Neha will walk through. Can you confirm which slot works and share the attendee list + timezone for each? I can then send a calendar invite and add the focused agenda items.

If Feb 24 is tight, we can also do Feb 25 morning but I want to avoid Thursday if BluePeak legal prefers earlier.

Best,
Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo this week — added stakeholders on our side

Hi all,

We can do Wed, Feb 25 at 11:00 AM PT but a few of our infra folks are still tentative — they travel back late on the 24th and might be slow to respond. If you can hold a Wed 11:00 slot tentatively, we'll confirm by EOD Monday the 23rd.

Also, security would like to see the following upfront so we can review before the call:
- Network topology and VPC/VPN options (high level)
- Data retention / deletion flow
- Audit log examples and retention policies

If you can mark the agenda with those bullets that will help us come prepared.

Thanks,
Rae Park
Sr. Security Engineer | BluePeak Ops Security

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Demo — Wed Feb 25 11:00 AM PT (tentative attendees)

Thanks for the quick coordination and confirming the tentative window. Per Rae's note, we're locking in Wed, Feb 25, 11:00–12:00 PM PT as the provisional time. Please confirm any final attendees by end of day tomorrow (Mon Feb 23) — if you need edits we'll adjust.

Attached: redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (slides), procurement-checklist.xlsx (procurement + terms primer). I added a short appendix (slide 12) on audit logs and retention and updated the architecture diagram for private deployments (slide 6).

Draft agenda (45–60m depending on Q&A):
- 10m: Introductions + use-case context (Michael)
- 25m: Demo + security controls (Lauren + Karthik)
- 10m: Procurement / SLAs / licensing overview (Neha)
- 10m: Infra + deployment patterns (Vivek)
- 5–10m: Next steps and mutual action plan (Hannah)

Action items for BluePeak:
- Reply with final attendee list and titles + timezone (required for calendar invites)
- Flag any contract clauses procurement wants pre-reviewed (Procurement contact)

I'll send a calendar invite to the confirmed list once BluePeak provides attendees. If Wed 25 gets blocked, we have Tue 24 9:00 AM PT as an alternate.

Calendar invite (to be sent): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-bluepeak-demo
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/BluePeak

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Best,
Lauren
